exam: 103年公務人員高等考試一級暨二級考試
subject: 英文(包括作文、翻譯與應用文)
classes: 文化行政(選試英文)(一般組)

essays.text:
英譯中：請將下列英文譯為中文。（每小題 10 分，共 20 分）
①Coral reefs are diverse underwater ecosystems held together by calcium carbonatestructures secreted by corals. Coral aquaculture, also known as coral farming, isshowing promise as a potentially effective tool for restoring coral reefs, which havebeen declining around the world.
②Marine protected areas (MPAs) have become increasingly prominent for reefmanagement. MPAs promote responsible fishery management and habitat protection.Much like national parks and wildlife refuges, and to varying degrees, MPAs restrictpotentially damaging activities.

中譯英：請將下列中文譯為英文。（每小題 10 分，共 20 分）
①基本上人是群體動物，須與其他個體發生有意義的互動以營造最大的身心健康與福祉。
②即使沒有不良習慣，孤寂仍會危害健康，因為它會提升壓力荷爾蒙並使發炎現象增加。
應用文：（30 分）假設你是一家出版社的負責人，因為讀者減少與少子化趨勢等等因素，感受到出版事業受到太多侷限。因此，請你寫一封正式的信函給文化部長，簡明扼要地請求他正視臺灣出版社面臨經營困難的問題，並請他提出具體的協助。此英文信的長度以250 字為限。
英文作文：（30 分）Write a well-organized English essay of no more than 300 words using specific detailsand providing examples on the following topic:The Role of Museums in a Changing World
